lines: There's a secret room hidden behind Mount Rushmore's faces.
There's a SECRET ROOM hidden behind Mount Rushmore's FACES.
[deadpan] Sure. And the noses are full of snacks.
Sure. And the NOSES are full of SNACKS.
No snacks. But the room is real... and something's in it.
No snacks. But the room is REAL... and something's IN it.
Before the carving, the Lakota knew this mountain as the Six Grandfathers.
Before the carving, the LAKOTA knew this mountain as the SIX GRANDFATHERS.
So how do you carve a face sixty feet tall? [excited] Dynamite.
So how do you carve a face SIXTY FEET tall? DYNAMITE.
[sarcastic] Ah, yes. The delicate art tool.
Ah, yes. The DELICATE art tool.
About ninety percent was blasted off, to within inches of the face.
About NINETY PERCENT was blasted off, to within INCHES of the face.
Then they drilled holes close together, like a honeycomb, and chipped the rest off.
Then they drilled holes close together, like a HONEYCOMB, and chipped the rest OFF.
Crews hung off the cliff to do it. In fourteen years, not one worker died.
Crews HUNG off the cliff to do it. In FOURTEEN YEARS, not one worker died.
Jefferson started on Washington's other side, but the rock was too cracked... so they blasted him off.
JEFFERSON started on Washington's OTHER side, but the rock was too CRACKED... so they BLASTED him off.
[deadpan] Dynamited out of the group photo. Brutal.
DYNAMITED out of the GROUP PHOTO. Brutal.
The sculptor planned a Hall of Records back here. They dug a seventy-foot tunnel... then work stopped.
The sculptor planned a HALL OF RECORDS back here. They dug a SEVENTY-FOOT tunnel... then work STOPPED.
In 1998, they sealed a titanium vault inside, under a twelve-hundred-pound granite lid.
In 1998, they sealed a TITANIUM VAULT inside, under a 1,200-POUND granite lid.
Porcelain panels... with the story of the carving and the country.
PORCELAIN PANELS... with the story of the CARVING and the COUNTRY.
[laughs] Basically. And granite wears away an inch every ten thousand years... so that secret room isn't going anywhere.
Basically. And granite wears away AN INCH every TEN THOUSAND YEARS... so that SECRET ROOM isn't going anywhere.
